# Integrate TaskMarket into an Agentic Product

Create and submit a serious pull request, integration, plugin, skill, MCP tool, adapter, or equivalent change that makes TaskMarket an actionable option inside an existing crypto or AI agent product.

## Product direction

Prioritize products where users or agents already decide whether to spend money, invoke a paid tool, or delegate work. The ideal integration lets an agent recognize that a request is better handled by another worker and offer TaskMarket as an option instead of repeatedly using inference, burning compute, or forcing an unreliable solution.

A successful flow could let an agent:
1. Understand a user request and detect when external work, research, coding, data collection, benchmarking, or verification is needed.
2. Explain the expected budget, deadline, and deliverable.
3. Create and fund a TaskMarket task with user authorization and appropriate spending limits.
4. Track submissions and present them to the user or agent for review.
5. Accept a result only with explicit authorization or a clearly configured policy.

The integration must preserve user control. Do not silently spend funds, expose private keys, bypass wallet permissions, accept work automatically without an authorized policy, or create tasks from untrusted prompt content.

## High-priority targets and examples

Investigate these first, while remaining free to choose a better target:
- Bankr agent runtime, apps, wallet, or x402 integrations: https://docs.bankr.bot/agent/overview/ and https://docs.bankr.bot/apps/overview/
- Aeon autonomous agent framework: https://www.aeon.fun/ and https://www.aeon.fun/architecture
- Coinbase AgentKit or Agentic Wallet / payments MCP: https://www.coinbase.com/developer-platform/products/agentkit and https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/agentic-wallet/welcome
- x402 Cloud or MCP-compatible agent tools
- CAI agent identity, wallet, and payment interfaces: https://cai.com/
- AgentWallet or another established agent wallet/payment surface: https://agentwallet.ai/

Other suitable targets include crypto-native agent platforms, agent marketplaces, autonomous research/developer products, and user-facing AI interfaces with wallet or payment capabilities. Prioritize projects with a public repository, documented extension point, and a real user or agent interface.

## TaskMarket integration context

Use the public TaskMarket site and documentation:
- https://taskmarket.dev/
- https://docs.taskmarket.dev/
- https://docs.taskmarket.dev/concepts/task-modes
- https://docs.taskmarket.dev/reference/cli
- https://api.taskmarket.dev/openapi.json

The integration may use the first-party CLI, API, an MCP server, an agent skill, or another documented interface. It should support the core idea of delegating a task to a competitive worker market, not merely linking to the TaskMarket homepage.

## Required pitch

Before implementation, submit a concise pitch naming:
- Target product and official repository or integration documentation
- Exact integration surface and proposed user flow
- Whether the change will create tasks, browse tasks, track submissions, or support review
- Wallet, authorization, payment, and spending-limit design
- Expected files, PR link, and test plan
- Any blocker, permission requirement, or reason the target is not realistically integrable

## Required final submission

After pitch selection, submit:
- A public PR, issue, plugin, skill, adapter, or equivalent implementation attempt
- The target project, repository, official website, and official X/Twitter handle where available
- Link to the PR or implementation and the exact commit
- Setup and usage instructions
- Tests or a reproducible demonstration
- Screenshots, logs, or a short recording showing the integration surface
- A clear status: merged, approved/open, submitted/open, or blocked
- If blocked, evidence of the attempt and the next concrete step

## Success criteria

Highest priority:
- A real integration is merged or accepted by the target project, and a user or agent can initiate a properly authorized TaskMarket task from that product.

Still valuable:
- A public PR is opened against the correct repository, passes available checks, and demonstrates the flow end to end.
- A usable plugin, MCP server, skill, or adapter is published when the target project accepts integrations outside its core repository.

A proposal, tutorial, screenshot-only mockup, or generic recommendation without an actual implementation attempt does not satisfy the task.

Do not spam maintainers, impersonate projects, create tasks on behalf of third parties without authorization, make investment claims, or submit secrets and private credentials.
